chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab (Rabab), from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

When the Day of Judgment comes, Paradise will call out to its Lord and say, 'O Lord, You are the Just, and You have filled Hell with its inmates as You promised it, yet You have not filled me as You promised me.' So Allah will create a creation who shall not have seen the world and will fill Paradise with them – blessed shall they be.
ai.seo_question: What happens to Paradise on the Day of Judgment according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from *Kitab al-Zuhd* illustrates the concept of *Khalq Jadid* (new creation) in Shia eschatology, where God creates beings who bypassed the earthly trial (*al-Dunya*) to directly enter Paradise, emphasizing divine mercy over strict retributive justice. It reflects the scholarly view that Paradise's capacity exceeds Hell's, allowing for this unique group of inhabitants who are spared the test of worldly life. The scene underscores the perfection of God's promise, as He ensures Paradise is fully populated according to His will.

en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 2.Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb, from Abū Jaʿfar (a) who said, “

When the Day of Judgment comes, Paradise will call out to its Lord and say, ‘O Lord, You are the Just, and You have filled Hellwith its inmates as You promised it, yet You have not filed me as You promised me.’ So Allah will create a creation who shall not have seen the world and will fill Paradise with them – blessed shall they be.”
